purpose: Teach: 隠そ/見渡し/励ん/史跡/貧しく/苦境/途絶え/撃ち

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不祥事を隠そうとするな
lines.en: Don't let us try to hide a scandal. Transparency first.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding opening. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands with weight. No room for negotiation in the tone. Brief pause between clauses for emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場全体を見渡す視点で進めます
lines.en: Yes. We'll approach this with a market-wide perspective.
lines.style: Respectful, measured. Steady voice. Professional but genuine — not robotic. Slight lean forward to show engagement. Measured pace, each word deliberate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新規事業に励んでいけ
lines.en: And push forward on new initiatives.
lines.style: Firm instruction, not a suggestion. Clipped delivery. Slight upward inflection on 'initiatives' — expecting action. Commanding but not harsh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域の史跡保存事業も提案します
lines.en: Yes. I'm also proposing we get involved in regional heritage preservation.
lines.style: Confident, slightly forward-leaning. Clear enunciation. Shows he's thought this through. Tone is measured, informative. Small pause before 'heritage' to signal weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 貧しく見積もるな、業績は伸ばせる
lines.en: Don't underestimate what we can achieve. Performance can grow from here.
lines.style: Assertive but not aggressive. Weight on 'don't' and 'grow.' Slower pace to let conviction land. Eyes hold steady. The tone of someone who believes this.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、苦境の中、再建を進めます
lines.en: Yes. Even now, in difficult times, we're moving forward with reconstruction.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Respectful cadence. Slight strain underneath — acknowledging the difficulty while pushing past it. Steady breathing, no tremor.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様との連絡が途絶えないように努めろ
lines.en: Keep our key clients in the loop. Don't let those lines go quiet.
lines.style: Direct instruction. Sharp, clear. Slight emphasis on 'keep' and 'don't.' Business-like but with an undercurrent of urgency. No softening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 市場の見渡しを社内で共有しろ。はい。広告の撃ち方を見直しております
lines.en: Yes. We're also reviewing how we structure our advertising campaigns — making sure we're hitting the right angles.
lines.style: Practical, detailed. Shows ongoing work. Measured pace with a touch of pride in the adjustment. Comfortable, competent tone. Not defensive, just informative.
